discovery_notes: 32 searches. Pins keyed under existing set_keys only. Christmas Carol advent 2024 per-pin fan pages are Disney Pins Blog shop pages (fan blog, not marketplace). Halloween 13-name list comes solely from MyPinCentral. Tails of Friendship pins come from AU/EU Disney Store listings tied to the collection by search summary (LE 1500, 2026 backstamp, codes 4380117xxxxx); treat as moderate. Magic of Disney: only Facilier (drop 2 by date) plus 6 series characters without drop. 25th Series 3 US code 438018656450 differs from EU 438019877908. Pascal AU listing also 'Coming Soon'. No suspicious/instructional content seen.
